item.title: Prince Mentioned Bin Laden Bombing America in 1998
item.description: During a December 1998 aftershow in Utrecht, Prince ad-libbed lyrics about Osama bin Laden bombing America and referenced 2001. The performance gained attention after 9/11, though records indicate “2001” also cued the band’s Also Sprach Zarathustra section.
